newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP 10-month copper concentrate output up.
newsitem.headline: BHP 10-month copper concentrate output up.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said its copper concentrate production rose 38 percent to 604,700 tonnes in the first 10 months, ended March 31, of its June-May year.
BHP said in its latest production report that its copper in concentrate production rose 24 percent in March to 63,600 tonnes from a year earlier.
Production and shipments of copper in concentrate from Chile were higher in March than in March last year due to the Phase III expansion at Escondida, it said.
Copper cathode production in Chile was higher due to higher plant availability and continuing process improvements, it said.
Copper in concentrate production from the Ok Tedi mine in Papua New Guinea was higher for March although shipments were lower due to low water levels in the Fly River.
Production and shipments of copper in concentrate in Peru were higher for March due to higher head grades and recoveries.
Production of copper anodes, which rose 10 percent to 41,200 tinnes in March, was higher due to higher sales demand.
Gold production in the United States was higher due to the processing of higher grade material, primarily Robinson concentrate, BHP added.
BHP copper production ('000 tonnes unless otherwise stated)
NOTE: March is the tenth month of BHP's financial year.
